articles.title: Store seeds between seasons
articles.summary: Dry containers, labels, and a cool shelf.

sections.title: Before storing
sections.body: Let the seed packet and container dry. A small paper envelope keeps each variety separate. Label it with the plant name and collection date.

sections.title: On the shelf
sections.body: Keep the envelopes in a closed, dry container away from sunlight. These are synthetic garden notes; storage needs vary by seed type.

articles.title: Clean hand tools after use
articles.summary: Remove soil and dry tools before putting them away.

sections.title: Remove soil
sections.body: Brush off loose soil. Wipe the handle and blade, then leave both to dry.

sections.title: Store separately
sections.body: Keep sharp tools in a covered tray. This is a fictional handbook entry, not equipment safety advice.

articles.title: Label a shared storage shelf
articles.summary: Use names that describe the items in each space.

sections.title: Group the items
sections.body: Keep items used together in one place. Give each shelf a short name based on its contents.

sections.title: Keep labels useful
sections.body: Update the label when the contents change. These local examples contain no account or shared service.

lessons.title: Read the axes
lessons.body: An axis label tells you what a number measures. Read the label and unit before comparing values.
lessons.question: The vertical axis is labeled ‘Minutes’. What does a value of 12 mean?

lessons.title: Compare two values
lessons.body: Compare values that share the same unit. A value of 18 minutes is 6 minutes greater than a value of 12 minutes.
